title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla finally gets New Game+ ⚔️
subject: acvalhalla
description:
Are you starting a new Valhalla run? 👇

Ubisoft released Assassin's Creed Valhalla's "The Most Requested Update" on November 5, 2026, adding New Game+, Mithril for upgrading Divine Gear, a stash system, new runes and a Master Assassin outfit inspired by Naoe from Assassin's Creed Shadows, plus upgraded PSSR support on PS5 Pro. Ubisoft says Valhalla has passed 40 million players.

Sources: PlayStation Blog (Nov 5, 2026), TheSixthAxis (Oct 30, 2026), KitGuru
Game footage © Ubisoft.

scenes.text: Assassin's Creed Valhalla finally has New Game Plus.
Ubisoft released it on November 5, almost six years after launch, and named the patch The Most Requested Update.
scenes.search: game controller close up dark room

scenes.text: Gear, runes and masteries now all feed into Eivor's power, and a new resource, Mithril, upgrades Divine Gear.
There's also a stash system and a Master Assassin outfit based on Naoe from Assassin's Creed Shadows.
PS5 Pro owners get upgraded PSSR support in the same update.
Ubisoft says more than 40 million people have now played Valhalla.
